id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

dataStoreId.description:
The data store ID that provides polling data for the progress bar.
The datastore should be a {@link UiApDataStore} that provides data for polling.

title.description: The title to display at the top of the progress bar.

subtitle.description: The subtitle/description text to display below the title.

backButtonText.description: The text for the back button.

failureMessage.description: The overall failure message to display when the process fails.

showFailedReason.description: Whether to show the failed reason for individual steps when they fail.

progressData.description:
The current progress data received from polling.
If the `dataStoreId` is not provided, this will be the only source of progress data. Will be used as a fallback.

title:
A full-page progress bar component that polls an API for progress updates.
The component displays overall progress and individual step statuses.
name: UiApProgressBar
